backup.title: Export & import

company.title: What should we call your workspace?

apiKeys.title: API keys
apiKeys.subtitle: An external system uses these to create projects and people and to read statistics. A key equals access to the whole company — revoke the ones you do not need.
apiKeys.scopesHint: The key can do only what is ticked. read:all is enough for reading statistics.
apiKeys.onceHint: It is shown once. Only its fingerprint is stored — not even we can recover it.
apiKeys.revokeHint: Revoking is immediate: any integration using it stops working at once.
apiKeys.adminOnly: Only a company admin manages keys.

integration.title: External system
integration.subtitle: The system your projects and people come from. Fill this in only if such an integration is set up.
integration.systemNameHint: This labels the link button in the project header.
integration.urlTemplateHint: Must contain {externalId} — the project identifier goes there. Without it every project would link to the same page.
integration.apiOnly: Projects are created through the API only
integration.apiOnlyHint: The “New project” button disappears for everyone, including the owner. Otherwise projects appear that the external system does not know about, and the lists drift apart.
integration.membersApiOnly: People come from the external system
integration.membersApiOnlyHint: The team stays visible here, but is added and removed only in your system. Prevents someone who was let go from keeping access here.

webhooks.title: Webhooks
webhooks.subtitle: We tell the external system about changes right away, so its statistics do not wait for polling.
webhooks.eventsHint: Nothing selected — we send everything. Every request is signed; the URL must be https.
webhooks.secretHint: Every request is signed with it — the receiving side verifies the signature. Shown once.
webhooks.empty: No webhooks yet — the external system learns about changes only by polling.

companyProfile.title: Company
companyProfile.subtitle: The whole team sees this name and logo — they appear in the header in place of ours.
companyProfile.name: Name
companyProfile.nameHint: This is how members see the company.

mail.title: Company email
mail.subtitle: Send letters from your own domain instead of ours — they look right to your people and pass spam filters better.
mail.providerDefaultHint: Letters go out from our domain. Fine for most teams.
mail.replyToHint: Where replies go. Leave empty to use the sender address.
mail.secretHint: Stored encrypted and never shown again, not even to you.
mail.verifiedAt: Checked by a real send on {{date}}
mail.disableConfirmBody: Your server settings and the saved password will be deleted. Letters will go out from our domain again.

companyStorage.subtitle: Where files from all projects are kept. Projects inherit this unless they set their own.
